fields.FIR_Description: As per the FIR recorded on 2025-11-17, the complainant discovered that jewellery kept in a cupboard had been taken from a place near Senthil Garden Main Street in Salem. The time of the incident was given as 00:50 on 2025-11-17. The complaint was lodged by Vidhya Devi (9000000062). Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Dharani Selvam, using the number 9000000038. Udhay Muthu (9000000352), described as a relative of the suspect, was also mentioned in the complaint. A witness, Ganesh Shankar, reachable on 9000000155, was mentioned in the complaint. The complainant mentioned CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect allegedly entered through an unsecured entry point.
fields.Keywords: property theft, valuables, CCTV, suspect, witness, mobile number, night, associate
